task: Switch Gitea browser login from APISIX reverse-proxy auth (X-WEBAUTH-USER) to Gitea's own 'keycloak' OAuth2 source with zero-click sign-in, GET /user/login forwarding, and in-place OAuth source upsert (D-GITEA-OAUTH, #491). Live Kakao rollout (Gitea values, OAuth source update, route push) is done separately by the orchestrator after merge.

events.summary: Switch Gitea browser login to Gitea's own 'keycloak' OAuth2 source (D-GITEA-OAUTH, #491): disable reverse-proxy auth and set USERNAME=preferred_username in 12-gitea.sh, retire D-GITEA-ADMIN seed and R285, add gitea_upsert_keycloak_source in scripts/common/lib.sh for 11-3 and 12, update ApisixRoute 'gitea' for zero-click OAuth redirect without forwarding gateway token headers, add 'gitea-login-forward' rule for GET /user/login with 60s loop guard and ?direct=1 escape hatch, update docs and add R287 + R287b.

Live Gitea 1.26.2 ran ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTHENTICATION=true with REVERSE_PROXY_AUTHENTICATION_USER=X-WEBAUTH-USER, which bypasses Gitea's OAuth2 group mappings (--admin-group cluster-admin, --group-team-map, --restricted-group guest). Both 11-3-keycloak-clients.sh and 12-gitea.sh ran `gitea admin auth delete --name keycloak 2>/dev/null || true`, which fails because `auth delete` accepts only `--id` (and DeleteSource returns ErrSourceInUse once any user links to the source), causing `add-oauth` to fail with ErrSourceAlreadyExist on every re-run while discarding stderr. Moreover, [oauth2_client] USERNAME defaults to 'nickname', which Keycloak does not emit, and cmd/admin_auth_oauth.go runUpdateOauth clears TwoFactorPolicy whenever --skip-local-2fa is omitted.
evidence: runtime:gitea admin auth list -> ID 1 Name keycloak Type OAuth2 Enabled true; gitea admin auth delete --help accepts only --id

doc:Gitea v1.26.2 models/auth/source.go CreateSource returns ErrSourceAlreadyExist for an existing name; with `auth delete --name` a no-op, the scripts' `add-oauth --name keycloak` cannot succeed while source 1 exists, and its stderr is discarded so only 'WARN: Gitea OAuth config failed' is printed

doc:Gitea v1.26.2 services/auth/source.go DeleteSource (ErrSourceInUse), cmd/admin_auth_oauth.go runUpdateOauth (--skip-local-2fa), routers/web/auth/oauth.go (USERNAME=preferred_username, ACCOUNT_LINKING=auto)
runtime:live Gitea users 2026-10-27 -> admin (local, source_id 0, is_admin true, created by reverse-proxy auto-registration and promoted by the D-GITEA-ADMIN seed), argocd, gitea-admin, portal-gitops
runtime:Keycloak realm narwhal client gitea example ID token/userinfo for admin -> preferred_username admin, groups [cluster-admin]; registrationAllowed=false

events.summary: 12-gitea.sh sets ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTHENTICATION=false, ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTO_REGISTRATION=false, and USERNAME=preferred_username (keeping REQUIRE_SIGNIN_VIEW off for anonymous ArgoCD package reads) and removes the D-GITEA-ADMIN seed block. scripts/common/lib.sh defines gitea_upsert_keycloak_source to look up Name=='keycloak' via `gitea admin auth list` and run `update-oauth --id <id>` (with --skip-local-2fa and all group mappings) or `add-oauth --name keycloak` without discarding stderr or logging the secret; 11-3 and 12 call it. apisix-routes.yaml disables set_userinfo_header/set_access_token_header/set_id_token_header on route 'gitea', clears X-WEBAUTH-USER unconditionally, redirects initial browser HTML GET navigations to /user/oauth2/keycloak with session cookie narwhal_gitea_sso=1, and adds rule 'gitea-login-forward' (priority 110, after gitea-git-bypass) to forward browser GET /user/login with 60s narwhal_gitea_sso_try loop guard and ?direct=1 escape hatch.
